fees.funding: charged at actual symbol-month settlement times when verified

conditional_rule: At 6h, a constituent with close_6h / entry_open - 1 > 0 exits at the selected 12h or 24h next-bar open; otherwise it exits at the 6h next-bar open.

selection.selection_gate: All three development-period paired mean deltas are positive; rank by minimum clipped paired-delta LCB.
selection.inferential_status: The minimum development-period clipped paired-delta LCB is negative; this is a selected diagnostic, not a passed statistical gate.

control.method: Existing same-symbol, same-random-time matched controls; same selected exit, native VectorBT fills, paired by event/member.

funding_evidence.source_policy: Local symbol-month history first; targeted public archive only for required missing months.
funding_evidence.clock_validation: Use official per-settlement funding_interval_hours where present; missing settlements are not zero-filled.
funding_evidence.note: The saved ALT audit contains remaining incomplete long-horizon funding rows; baseline reconciliation is separately documented by the parent task.

risk_trajectory.method: 2026 constituent marks, event-time member average, fixed-notional additive returns; no compounding.
